scheme_name: Scheme for Grant of Financial Assistance for Administering Road Safety Advocacy and Awards for the Outstanding Work Done in the Field of Road Safety
other_conditions: The applicant agency must be an NGO/Trust registered under the Indian Trusts Act, a Cooperative Society under the Societies Registration Act, a Firm registered under the Companies Act (1956/2013), or an Academic Institution accredited/affiliated or recognized as a University/Deemed University by the UGC Act
If the applicant agency is an NGO, it must be registered on the NITI Aayog DARPAN platform and provide its Unique ID while submitting the proposal
The agency must provide documentary evidence such as a Work Order, Letter of Award, or Contract showing undertaking of a road‑safety or advocacy programme for grants‑in‑aid
The agency may undertake the assignment individually or form a joint‑venture (JV) with at most two members, appointing a lead member and agreeing to joint‑and‑several terms
The agency should have completed at least one road‑safety or advocacy/awareness programme in the last three years as of the proposal submission date
The agency must not be blacklisted or debarred by any State or Central Government entity from receiving funds
Only projects involving road‑safety activities or advocacy/awareness on any social cause are eligible for financial assistance
benefits_summary: Financial assistance (milestone‑wise or single‑stage) is provided for road‑safety advocacy programmes, and awards of up to ₹5 lakhs (first prize) plus certificates are given to outstanding agencies or individuals.
documents_required: Work Order/Letter of Award/Contract (or similar documentary evidence)
PAN Card of the NGO/Trust/Cooperative Society/Firm
Bank details of the agency (mandatory for proposal submission)
